exclude_export_details.description: Determines whether a summary of the exported rules is returned.

file_name.description:
File name for saving the exported rules.
> info
> When using cURL to export rules to a file, use the -O and -J options to save the rules to the file name specified in the URL.

objects.description: Array of objects with a rule's `rule_id` field. Do not use rule's `id` here. Exports all rules when unspecified.
